style: Square 1:1 item icon for VELSTRIA, a premium fantasy mobile MOBA game. AAA game item-icon quality: hand-painted semi-realistic digital painting, crisp detail, rich believable materials (forged metal, gemstones, leather, carved wood, enchanted energy), dramatic rim lighting and strong value contrast so the silhouette reads instantly even when the icon is shown at 40 pixels. Exactly ONE object — the item described below — shown whole (nothing cropped by the frame), large and centered, filling about 75% of the frame. Long items (blades, bows, staves) lie on a diagonal with the grip / handle toward the bottom-left corner and the tip / head toward the top-right corner; talismans and armor are shown front-on in a slight 3/4 view. Armor is displayed empty and freestanding — no wearer, no body, no mannequin, no head or arms — with a broad, flat, gender-neutral chest (no bust shaping, no corseted waist). A talisman's cord or chain stays short and inside the frame. Background: dark, mostly near-black toward the edges, with a softly blurred cosmic nebula tinted {background} concentrated in a soft glow behind the item and a few faint stars, so the brightly lit item clearly stands out from it; no scenery, no characters, no hands, no pedestal. Magical glyph patterns are fine, but absolutely no readable text, letters, numbers, logos, signature, watermark, border, frame or UI elements. Full-bleed square image; keep a thin strip along the bottom edge darker and free of important detail (small tier markers are overlaid there).

tiers.1: Tier 1 (starter item): solid, well-made craftsmanship with simple, mostly unadorned forms and a single modest accent; only a faint touch of magic glow.
tiers.2: Tier 2 (advanced item): refined craftsmanship with engraved details, inlaid gems or precious-metal fittings, and a clearly visible enchantment glow.
tiers.3: Tier 3 (legendary item): a masterwork relic — ornate gilded details, a large glowing core gem or crystal, an intense magical aura with drifting light particles; the most impressive and luxurious version, unmistakably top tier.

Attack.accent: Category accent (attack): blazing crimson-red and ember-orange highlights and glow, sharp aggressive edges, tiny sparks.

Magic.accent: Category accent (magic): luminous violet and amethyst arcane glow, softly floating arcane glyph rings and motes.

Defense.accent: Category accent (defense): cool sapphire and sky-blue protective glow, sturdy reinforced construction, a faint hexagonal barrier shimmer.

Movement.accent: Category accent (movement): bright aquamarine and mint-teal glow, flowing wind or water streaks that suggest speed, feather or fin motifs.

Utility.accent: Category accent (support): warm amber-gold holy glow, soft healing light, gentle radiant motes.

Jungle.accent: Category accent (jungle): vivid emerald and leaf-green glow, living vines, leaves, moss or beast-claw and fang motifs from the wild jungle.

items.name: Dawn Dagger
items.concept_ja: 朝焼けの光を刃に宿す、真鍮鍔と日長石柄頭の素朴な狩猟短剣
items.description: A short single-edged hunting dagger with a straight steel blade whose edge catches a warm pink-gold sunrise gleam, a simple brass crossguard and a grip wrapped in worn red leather, a small round sunstone in the pommel glowing a faint ember orange like the first sliver of the rising sun.

items.name: Nautilus Staff
items.concept_ja: 白い流木の先にオウムガイの渦巻き殻、小さな真珠が淡く光る素朴な杖
items.description: A slender driftwood staff bleached pale by the sea, its head a curled spiral nautilus shell holding a small glowing aquamarine pearl, a few strands of kelp-green cord and tiny barnacles near the top, a faint ribbon of sea water swirling gently around the shaft.

items.name: Jade Leaf Cuirass
items.concept_ja: 葉形の革板を重ねた狩人の胴鎧、波紋を刻んだ翡翠の小石
items.description: A simple jungle hunter's cuirass of smooth boiled leather molded into broad overlapping leaf-shaped plates, with rounded shoulder caps, pale green stitching and dull bronze rivets along the edges. At the sternum sits a small flat polished river stone of pale jade carved with three calm concentric ripple rings, giving off only a faint emerald glimmer, and a soft tuft of moss is tucked along the collar.

items.name: Wayfarer Boots
items.concept_ja: 旅人が履き込んだ素朴な茶革の短靴、ストラップに青緑の羽根一枚
items.description: A pair of plain, well-worn brown leather travel boots with simple stitched soles and a single buckled strap, one small teal-green feather tucked under the strap, a faint wisp of mint-teal breeze curling around the heels.

items.name: Blazing Talisman
items.concept_ja: 厚い青銅の円盤に炎紋を浮き彫りにした素朴な護符
items.description: A sturdy round talisman of thick hammered bronze hanging from a short braided leather cord, its face embossed with a simple raised three-tongued flame emblem, a small polished carnelian ember stone set at the base of the flame giving off a faint warm amber glow; plain beveled rim and an honest worn patina on the metal.

items.name: Stariron Hunting Bow
items.concept_ja: 星斑の隕鉄で打った細身のリカーブ弓、握りに小さな青い星鋲
items.description: A slim short recurve bow with limbs of dark blue-black meteoric stariron, the metal flecked with tiny silvery star specks like a night sky, gently curled tips capped in plain steel, a simple brown leather-wrapped grip with a single small pale-blue star-shaped stud, and a plain taut waxed string.

items.name: Thunderclap Dagger
items.concept_ja: 稲妻の溝と、二股の稲妻のように折れた鍔を持つ質素な鋼の短剣
items.description: A plain straight double-edged dagger of dark storm-gray steel with a narrow, sharply tapering blade and a single zigzag lightning-bolt groove etched down its center that glimmers faintly crimson. Its iron crossguard bends at both ends into sharp angular zigzag hooks like a forked bolt; the grip is wrapped in charcoal leather cord with a small round copper pommel. A few tiny ember-red sparks crackle off the tip.

items.name: Whirlwind Staff
items.concept_ja: 素朴なトネリコの杖、先端が旋風の渦を描く鉤に羽根を一枚結ぶ
items.description: A plain pale ash-wood walking staff with a shallow spiral groove down the shaft, its top curling over into a single open spiral hook like a gust of wind, a lone grey-white hawk feather tied beneath the curl with a simple leather cord, a small smooth aquamarine bead set in the center of the spiral, and one faint mint-teal wisp of breeze drifting around the hook.

items.name: Voidsteel Breastplate
items.concept_ja: 星屑混じりの黒鋼一枚胸当て、胸元に小さな虚空の輪
items.description: A plain rounded cuirass hammered from matte black voidsteel, its single smooth chest plate faintly speckled with tiny silver star-flecks as if cut from the night sky, edged in simple moss-green quilted padding and fastened with two worn brown leather straps. At the sternum sits a small hollow ring of dark void, its rim lit by a thin, faint emerald glow.

items.name: Sprinter Sandals
items.concept_ja: 細い革紐を編み上げた軽量のサンダル、紐の結び目に小さな水宝玉
items.description: A pair of light leather lace-up sprinter sandals with thin criss-crossed cords wrapped up the ankle, a thin flexible sole, one small smooth aquamarine bead set in the knot of the cords, a faint streak of wind trailing behind the heels.

items.name: Spiritwood Acorn Charm
items.concept_ja: 霊樹を削ったどんぐり形の種の護符、ひびから琥珀の光が漏れる
items.description: A small charm carved from pale ivory spiritwood in the shape of an upright acorn-like seed pod with a textured little cap, a single tiny sage-green leaf sprouting from the cap, warm amber light glowing softly through a thin natural crack in the grain, hung on a simple braided hemp cord threaded with one small honey-amber bead; otherwise plain and smooth.

items.name: Sentinel Longbow
items.concept_ja: 握りに鋼の小盾を鋲留めした、素朴なトネリコの番兵の長弓
items.description: A sturdy plain longbow of dark seasoned ash wood in a simple deep D-shaped arc, its limb tips capped with plain iron, the grip wrapped in brown leather and guarded by a small round steel buckler disc riveted over its face, a single tiny sapphire stud at the buckler's center giving off a faint blue gleam, and a taut pale linen string.

items.name: Sunrise Bronze Dagger
items.concept_ja: 地平に昇る半日輪を柄頭にした、古代青銅の木の葉形両刃短剣
items.description: An ancient short dagger with a wide leaf-shaped double-edged bronze blade, swelling at the middle and tapering to a sharp point, its raised central ridge glinting with a rose-gold sunrise sheen. It has no crossguard: the plain grip is wrapped in tan cord and capped by a flat half-disc pommel shaped like the sun just rising over the horizon, its short carved rays tipped with a faint ember glow.

items.name: Whalebone Staff
items.concept_ja: 鯨骨を削り出し、潜る鯨のように上向き V 字の尾びれを頂いた素朴な杖
items.description: A plain staff carved from a single length of polished grey-white whalebone, its top end shaped as a whale's tail fluke rising straight up out of the shaft like a diving whale, the two smooth flukes spreading upward and outward in a wide V, a small round sea-glass bead of pale aquamarine set where the flukes meet, a simple band of tarred navy rope binding the grip, a thin streak of sea water trailing from the fluke tips.

items.name: Bamboo Lamellar Vest
items.concept_ja: 竹札を緑紐で綴じた直線的な袖なし胴、石の静水円盤
items.description: A sleeveless lamellar vest of vertical lacquered bamboo slats laced together with leaf-green cord, a straight, tall rectangular silhouette with a squared high collar and no shoulder plates, cinched by a plain grey-green cloth sash. A small round still-pond disc of grey slate sits on the chest, its concentric ripple rings faintly lit emerald, with a single dewdrop-shaped green bead hanging beneath it.

items.name: Sea Breeze Boots
items.concept_ja: 波模様の縫い目を巡らせた、淡い青の革張りの船乗りの長靴
items.description: A pair of pale sea-blue leather sailor boots with a turned-down cuff, a neat wave-pattern stitched around the shaft in pale thread, plain brass eyelets, and a faint salty mist swirling softly around the toes.

items.name: Amber Flame Pendant
items.concept_ja: 一筋の炎の形に削り出した琥珀の小さなペンダント
items.description: A small flat pendant cut in the silhouette of a single upright candle flame, three curling tongues rising to one pointed tip, carved from warm translucent orange amber and capped with a plain copper bail on a thin copper chain; a tiny spark of golden light glows faintly deep inside the amber, otherwise clean and unadorned.

items.name: Meteoric Heavy Bow
items.concept_ja: 鋲留めの星鉄板を重ねた頑丈な長弓、握りに荒削りの隕石塊
items.description: A tall, sturdy longbow with broad, flat, almost straight limbs built from overlapping riveted stariron plates, dark gunmetal flecked with faint silver star specks, squared-off blunt tips, the grip formed around a rough unpolished chunk of black meteorite with a faint blue glint in its cracks, bound with thick grey leather bands, and a heavy braided string with a faint blue sheen.

items.name: Lightning Silver Dagger
items.concept_ja: 刀身そのものが稲妻形に折れ曲がる銀の短剣、雷雲の鍔とルビー
items.description: A refined dagger whose polished storm-silver blade is forged in the shape of a lightning bolt, bending in three sharp angular zigzags to a needle point, its edges glowing hot crimson with flickering arcs of electricity. Engraved swirling storm-cloud patterns cover the blade's base, the silver crossguard curls into two small thunderclouds, and a faceted ruby is set at its center. Dark slate-blue leather grip, silver-capped pommel.

items.name: Windvane Staff
items.concept_ja: 銀の風見車を戴く杖、羽根形の四枚刃が宝玉の軸を中心に疾風で回る
items.description: A slender staff of pale silver steel with engraved silver ferrules and a spiral wind groove, crowned by a weathervane pinwheel of four curved, feather-shaped silver blades etched with swirling cloud patterns, turning around a faceted aquamarine hub gem that glows brightly, while a ring of mint-teal wind streaks whirls around the blades as if they are spinning in a gale.

items.name: Serpent Scale Armor
items.concept_ja: 密林の大蛇の鱗を重ねた高襟の札鎧、中央に虚空の雫石
items.description: A tapered lamellar breastplate built from overlapping obsidian-black scales like the hide of a jungle serpent, each scale edged in engraved silver and flecked with tiny stars, rising into a tall standing collar. In the center of the chest a polished void-black teardrop gem in a silver vine-engraved mount pulls a swirling emerald glow inward, and soft green light seeps between the scales.

items.name: Falconfeather Boots
items.concept_ja: 足首に銀の隼の翼を備えた、鋼の縁取りの軽快な革靴
items.description: A pair of slim boots of fine dark teal leather with polished steel toe caps and trim, a small swept-back silver wing shaped like a falcon feather on each ankle, a tiny aquamarine gem on the instep, and a clear glow of mint-teal wind around them.

items.name: Spiritwood Leaf Pendant
items.concept_ja: 金線の葉脈を象嵌した、一枚葉をかたどる霊樹のペンダント
items.description: A vertical pendant carved from pale ivory spiritwood in the shape of a single broad pointed leaf, its veins inlaid with fine gold wire glowing soft amber, a polished oval amber cabochon set at the stem, a tiny sage-jade bud carved at the tip, hanging from a delicate silver chain, warm golden light seeping through the thin translucent wood edges.

items.name: Ivory Shield Bow
items.concept_ja: 象牙色のリカーブ弓に、銀の凧形盾と蒼玉の結界
items.description: An elegant recurve bow of pale ivory-white wood with silver fittings, both limbs sweeping back into sharp hooked tips, the grip fronted by a polished silver kite-shaped shield plate engraved with flowing ward lines and inlaid with an oval sapphire, thin silver bands wrapping the limbs, and a sky-blue glowing string that sheds a soft veil of protective light.

items.name: Daybreak Hook Dagger
items.concept_ja: 昇る陽光の彫刻が灯る、日長石とガーネット象嵌の鉤形湾曲短剣
items.description: A curved dagger with a deeply hooked, sharply curving double-edged blade of rose-tinted steel, an engraved fan of rising-sun rays along its central ridge glowing ember orange. The short flared hilt is chased rose-gold inlaid with a row of small garnets, and its rounded pommel cap holds a faceted orange sunstone radiating a clear crimson-gold enchantment glow, with fine sparks trailing off the curved edge.

items.name: Ghost Coral Staff
items.concept_ja: 白い幽霊珊瑚が枝角のように広がり、銀細工で海宝石を抱く上級の杖
items.description: A refined staff of pale ivory ghost-coral whose head splits into an upswept spray of branching, antler-like coral fronds with softly glowing teal tips, cradling a faceted aquamarine gem in silver filigree at their center; the shaft is engraved with flowing wave lines and banded with small inlaid pearls, and a luminous mint-teal current spirals up through the branches.

items.name: Lotus Jade Breastplate
items.concept_ja: 蓮の花弁が開く翡翠鋼の胸当て、銀の波紋彫りと月長石
items.description: A refined breastplate of polished pale jade-green steel built from layered lotus-petal plates that open upward and outward, forming wide petal-shaped shoulder flares and a scalloped collar. Fine silver engravings of calm ripple rings flow across every petal. In the heart of the lotus, a round moonstone ringed by small emeralds sits in a ripple-ring silver setting, glowing clear emerald light, with slender silver vine tendrils curling along the waist.

items.name: Waterwalker Boots
items.concept_ja: 水面に波紋を描く彫りを施した、水宝石の留め具を持つブーツ
items.description: A pair of tall sleek boots of deep blue-green leather engraved with concentric ripple rings and silver fittings, a faceted aquamarine clasp at each ankle, the soles hovering just above a thin disc of gently rippling water, soft mist rising around them.

items.name: Hearthfire Lantern Pendant
items.ja: 炉火のランタンペンダント
items.concept_ja: 炉の火を閉じ込めた金細工の籠型ランタンペンダント
items.description: A hearth-lantern pendant: a small octagonal cage of gilded bronze filigree with a pointed flame-shaped finial on top and a sturdy ring for the chain, its frame engraved with flame scrollwork, holding a faceted ember-orange fire opal that floats inside with a living flame flickering within it; clearly visible amber-gold light spills out through the openwork.

items.name: Hexscale Scythian Bow
items.concept_ja: 六角の星鉄鱗で覆った二重湾曲のスキタイ弓、握りにサファイア
items.description: A deeply curved double-arched Scythian-style bow whose limbs are armored with overlapping hexagonal scales of polished blue-black stariron, each scale edged in engraved silver with star-specked metal glinting between them, a faceted sapphire set in a silver-capped grip, sharply swept-back recurved tips ending in small silver star finials, and a softly glowing sky-blue string.

items.name: Rumbling Wedge Dagger
items.concept_ja: 雷鳴の衝撃波紋が広がる幅広の楔形短剣、根元に柘榴石の核
items.description: A broad, wedge-shaped dagger in the style of a cinquedea, its blade very wide at the hilt and tapering in straight lines to a sharp point, forged from dark gunmetal steel. Engraved concentric shockwave rings ripple outward across the wide base from an inset round garnet, the rings glowing ember-crimson like the boom of a thunderclap, with thin jagged lightning threads running along both edges. Downswept bronze crossguard, black-wrapped grip, flat disc pommel.

items.name: Swift Dive Staff
items.concept_ja: 急降下する雨燕を象った銀の穂先、後ろへ流れる翼から疾風の尾が伸びる
items.description: A sleek white-birch staff topped by a polished silver head shaped like a diving swift, its long pointed wings swept back tight along the shaft into sharp trailing vanes engraved with fine feather lines, a glowing teardrop aquamarine set as the bird's eye, and a bright mint-teal slipstream pouring off the wingtips in long streaks, as if the staff were cutting through a gale.

items.name: Beetle Shell Armor
items.concept_ja: 角付き肩の甲虫殻胴鎧、正中の虚空の裂け目が翠に光る
items.description: A broad, heavy cuirass shaped like a giant jungle beetle's carapace: two glossy black-indigo shell halves meet down the center and flare into wide curved shoulder guards, each ending in a short upswept horn. A jagged void crack runs down the central seam, glowing vivid emerald from within, flanked by three small inlaid emerald cabochons, with fine engraved leaf-vein lines across the shell.

items.name: Cloudstride Boots
items.concept_ja: 雲の渦巻きを銀で象嵌した、白い革の軽やかな長靴
items.description: A pair of elegant white-and-silver boots of supple pale leather with silver scrollwork inlaid in the shape of rolling clouds up the shafts, rolled soft cuffs, a small turquoise gem on each ankle, and swirls of clean wind curling beneath the soles.

items.name: Crescent Rootcradle Amulet
items.concept_ja: 編み根の三日月の揺り籠に、琥珀の種石が浮かぶ護符
items.description: A crescent-shaped charm of three living spiritwood roots braided into a smooth U-shaped cradle, pale ivory with amber light seeping through the grain, bound by engraved gold bands, its two upturned tips each sprouting a tiny sage-jade leaf; floating in the hollow of the crescent, touching nothing, hovers a round faceted amber seed gem radiating a clearly visible honey-gold glow.

items.name: Lamellar Fortress Bow
items.concept_ja: 騎士の肩当てのような鋼の小札を重ねた、重装の城塞弓
items.description: A heavy compact reflex bow forged from overlapping steel lamellar plates like a knight's pauldron, its thick angular limbs stepped in layered segments fastened with bronze rivets, a broad heater-shield plate bolted across the grip and set with a hexagonal sapphire, glowing sky-blue seams running between the plates, the short limbs ending in squared steel caps, and a braided steel-grey string.

items.name: Lark Kris
items.concept_ja: 陽炎のように波打つクリス刃と、翼を広げた黎明の雲雀の鍔
items.description: A wavy kris dagger whose rippling flame-shaped blade of pale pink damascus steel glows ember red along both edges like heat shimmering at sunrise. The guard is a gilded songbird, a dawn lark with its wings spread wide to either side of the blade, a small garnet eye and engraved feathers; a polished oval sunstone set in the bird's breast pulses with warm crimson-orange light above a slim rose-gold grip.

items.name: Lure Lantern Staff
items.concept_ja: 黒鉄の鉤形の杖先から、深海の発光ルアー玉を吊るした上級の杖
items.description: A refined staff of blackened abyssal iron etched with fine fish-scale engravings and bright silver fittings, its top curving over into a tall slender hooked crook like a deep-sea lure stalk, from whose tip hangs a glowing bioluminescent aquamarine orb on a short silver tendril, small pearls studding the curve, faint mint-teal light trails and rising bubbles drifting from the hanging orb.

items.name: Tortoise Shell Cuirass
items.concept_ja: 苔むす森亀の甲羅を象った丸い胸甲、中央の翠玉が静かに光る
items.description: A domed oval breastplate shaped like the shell of an ancient forest tortoise, its smooth rounded pebble-like segments of dark bronze-green metal outlined with engraved gold ripple lines, soft emerald moss and tiny ferns growing along the seams and rim, short rounded scale-plate shoulder guards. A gold-framed round emerald set in the central segment glows steadily, sending calm concentric rings of green light across the shell.

items.name: Fleetfoot Greaves
items.concept_ja: 流線形の漆塗り青緑の札を重ねた、金の一筋の走る脚甲
items.description: A pair of sleek, streamlined greaves and boots of lacquered teal lamellar plates overlapping like fish scales, a single thin golden stripe running along each shin, engraved speed-lines, a faint aquamarine glow in the seams, and a streak of wind trailing behind.

items.name: Salamander Copper Talisman
items.concept_ja: 尾を咥えて輪になった火蜥蜴の銅護符、中心に火蛋白石の雫
items.description: A round amulet of polished rose-copper shaped as a fire salamander curled into a closed ring, biting its own flame-tipped tail, its back ridged with engraved flame scrollwork and inlaid gold, and in the open center of the ring a teardrop fire opal hanging free, burning with a clearly visible amber-gold glow, thin orange flame wisps rising from the salamander's spine.

items.name: Constellation Bow
items.concept_ja: 星座のように蒼玉を連ねた星鉄の弓、握りを巡る光の輪
items.description: An elegant bow forming one smooth deep arc with long tapered pointed tips, its polished silver-blue stariron limbs studded with a row of small inlaid sapphires linked by fine engraved silver lines like a constellation, a pale starlight-white grip of wrapped silk cord, a thin ring of blue light orbiting the grip, and a glowing sky-blue string.

items.name: Homecore Talisman
items.concept_ja: 帰る場所の炉心を抱く要石型メダリオン、矢じりの環が全て核へ向かう伝説の護符
items.description: A legendary talisman medallion shaped like a pointed-arch fortress keystone in gilded bronze and blackened iron, its center a huge blazing crimson core crystal glowing like a miniature hearth-fire. Around the core, a gold ring of curved arrowheads all point inward toward it, like paths leading home. Short blade-like spikes jut from the rim, a sturdy chain loop sits at the top, and ember sparks spiral back into the core inside a red-orange aura.

items.name: Tempest Chalice Staff
items.concept_ja: 黄金の杯から竜巻が立ち昇り、嵐の目に巨大な宝晶が輝く伝説の杖
items.description: A legendary staff of pearl-white wood bound by gilded spiral bands, its head an ornate gilded cup of curling golden wind-vanes from which a living miniature tornado rises, a tall glowing aquamarine funnel twisting upward, with a huge faceted aquamarine core crystal blazing in the eye of the storm, mint-teal wind ribbons spiraling down the shaft and sparkling light motes caught in the whirl.

items.name: Vinecrest Knight Cuirass
items.concept_ja: 金の蔦が根を張る騎士胸甲、胸に翠光を呑む虚空の渦核
items.description: A legendary knightly breastplate of starless black voidsteel with a high gilded gorget and gilded rims, ornate gold vine filigree spreading across the plate like roots. Its heart holds a large swirling void vortex, a black-hole core ringed by a blazing emerald halo of light, pulling drifting green light particles in a spiral toward it, while a deep emerald and indigo aura billows around the armor.

items.name: Skyward Winged Boots
items.concept_ja: 金の翼を踵から広げ、中心に大きな水宝玉の核を抱く伝説の靴
items.description: A pair of legendary golden-and-white boots with ornate filigree on the shafts, a large pair of feathered golden wings spread from the heels of each boot, a big glowing aquamarine core gem set at the ankle, bright light particles and gentle sky-blue wind trailing from them.

items.name: Hollow Tree Pendant
items.concept_ja: 幹の洞に巨大な琥珀の心核を抱く、聖樹そのものを象ったペンダント
items.description: A legendary pendant carved as a miniature sacred spiritwood tree: a broad dome-shaped canopy of gilded leaves on top, a thick twisting ivory trunk with glowing amber grain, and strong roots splaying out at the base, set in an ornate gold ring that the branches break through; a huge amber heart-crystal embedded in the hollow of the trunk pours out warm golden light, drifting motes and a soft halo around the canopy.

items.name: Guardian Angel Bow
items.concept_ja: 金銀の翼を広げ、円盾の中心に巨大な蒼玉核を抱く守護天使の弓
items.description: A legendary bow whose two limbs are great sweeping wings of gilded silver feathers curving outward, each layered feather edged in glowing sapphire light, the wings meeting at the grip in a round gilded aegis shield boss that holds a huge radiant sapphire core, a string of pure sky-blue light, drifting blue light motes and a faint hexagonal barrier shimmer haloing the whole bow.

items.name: Sunwheel Relic Dagger
items.concept_ja: 巨大な日輪の光輪鍔と灼熱の日長石を抱く、幅広三角刃の聖遺物
items.description: A legendary broad short dagger with a wide triangular blade of polished rose-gold steel, a molten channel of liquid sunlight running down its center to the tip. The guard is a large gilded sun-disc ring with sharp radiating rays encircling the base of the blade, a huge blazing sunstone set at its hub burning white-gold at the core and crimson at the rim, wrapped in an aura of ember sparks and drifting golden motes.

items.name: Pearl Shell Staff
items.concept_ja: 扇のように開く黄金の帆立貝が巨大な海の真珠核を抱く伝説の杖
items.description: A legendary staff of deep navy abyssal steel with gilded fittings and iridescent mother-of-pearl inlay, crowned by a large gilded scallop shell opening upward like a fan, its ribs lined with glowing mother-of-pearl, cradling a huge radiant aquamarine pearl core; a spinning vortex of luminous mint-teal water and pearl bubbles spirals around the shell, small golden fins flare from the collar, drifting light particles.

items.name: Stillwater Cuirass
items.concept_ja: 蓮葉の肩当てと鏡のような翠の静水核を抱く伝説の胴鎧
items.description: A legendary cuirass of black-lacquered ironwood with broad, round, ornately gilded lily-pad pauldrons beaded with glowing dew. The whole chest is a large circular still-pond core: a glowing emerald crystal disc like mirror-calm water with a gilded lotus blossom floating at its center, concentric rings of green light rippling outward across the armor. Living moss and trailing vines drape the edges inside an intense emerald aura of drifting firefly motes.

items.name: Stormcrosser Boots
items.concept_ja: 靴を巡る嵐の輪と稲妻の波模様を持つ、深い青緑の長靴
items.description: A pair of tall legendary storm-sailor boots of deep teal leather with gilded cuffs and a swirling ring of tempest clouds orbiting each ankle, a forked pale-blue lightning wave-pattern embossed up the shafts, a big glowing aquamarine crystal at the cuff, driving rain streaks and wind in the aura.

items.name: Phoenix Necklace
items.concept_ja: 翼を広げた金の不死鳥が巨大な陽光琥珀を胸に抱く至宝
items.description: A legendary sculpted phoenix medallion of ornate gilded gold, the firebird's wings spread wide and upswept to form the outline, each feather a tongue of molten-orange enamel edged in gold, its tail flaring below in three flame plumes; a huge glowing sun-amber core crystal set in the breast radiates intense golden healing light, wreathed in a soft amber aura with drifting ember and gold motes.

items.name: Meteor Fortress Bow
items.concept_ja: 落ちた星のような隕石塊を握りに抱き、星鉄の装甲肢を張り出す要塞弓
items.description: A legendary fortress bow whose massive riser is a huge raw chunk of glowing meteorite set in gilded stariron bracing, a blazing faceted sapphire star core shining from inside it like a fallen star; its broad angular limbs are built from stepped, layered dark star-specked stariron plates jutting outward like rampart wings, small meteor fragments orbiting the bow, drifting silver-blue sparks and a radiant string of pure light.

items.name: Crimson Bolt Dagger
items.concept_ja: 金の雷雲の鍔から二股の紅い雷そのものの刃が伸びる伝説の短剣
items.description: A legendary dagger with no steel blade: from an ornate gilded crossguard sculpted as a billowing thundercloud rises a blade of solid crackling crimson lightning, white-hot at its core, that splits near the tip into two forked prongs like a branching bolt. A huge glowing ruby core pulses in the heart of the golden cloud, above a dark slate grip. Ember sparks and tiny branching arcs drift around it in an intense storm aura.

items.name: Armillary Staff
items.concept_ja: 三重の黄金天球環が、嵐を封じた紡錘形の巨晶を巡る至宝の杖
items.description: A legendary white-gold staff whose head is an ornate gilded armillary sphere of three interlocking rings engraved with swirling cloud patterns, tilted at different angles around a huge elongated aquamarine crystal spindle that blazes like a captured storm, bright mint-teal wind bands orbiting the rings in sweeping arcs, a pair of small gilded feather fins flaring beneath the sphere, and drifting light particles circling the head.

items.name: Void Panther Cuirass
items.concept_ja: 虚空の黒豹の頭を象る胸甲、牙の顎に星渦の翠晶を抱く
items.description: A legendary predator cuirass whose chest is sculpted into the snarling head of a great black void-panther, gilded fangs framing open jaws that cradle a large blazing emerald crystal swirling with tiny stars. Gilded claw-shaped ribs curl around both flanks like a beast's grip, the black plate shimmering with starry void like a night-sky pelt, wrapped in an intense emerald aura of drifting leaf-shaped light motes.

items.name: Starsea Strider Boots
items.concept_ja: 星屑を散らした深い青緑の靴に、金の波ヒレが走る至宝
items.description: A pair of masterwork boots of deep ocean-teal leather speckled with silver star-flecks as if cut from a night sea, golden wave-shaped fins sweeping up the shafts, a large star-shaped aquamarine crystal on each ankle, drifting luminous droplets and a shimmering tide of light under the soles.

items.name: Spirit Stag Talisman
items.concept_ja: 霊鹿の枝角を冠に、巨大な琥珀の雫結晶を抱く聖獣の護符
items.description: A legendary medallion crowned by a pair of tall branching spiritwood antlers sweeping upward and outward like a forest spirit stag's crown, ivory tines veined with glowing amber grain, tipped with gold and sprouting tiny sage-jade leaves; between the antler bases, bound in ornate gilded filigree, hangs a huge faceted amber teardrop crystal blazing with golden light, an intense aura of amber motes rising between the tines.

items.name: Heavenly Ring Bow
items.concept_ja: ほぼ円環を描く白銀の弓、内側に六角結界が満ちる天穹の守護弓
items.description: A legendary celestial bow of starlit white-silver curved into a deep arc that nearly closes into a full circle, its limb tips almost touching, the grip mounted with a gilded heater-shield plate holding a huge faceted sapphire crystal, a string of pure white-blue light, and filling the inside of the ring a translucent shimmering dome of hexagonal barrier cells glowing sapphire, with tiny light motes drifting around it.

items.name: Morningstar Comet Dagger
items.concept_ja: 明けの明星の四芒星鍔と、朝焼け色の結晶刃が彗星の尾を引く秘宝
items.description: A legendary dagger whose slender, gently curved blade is a single shard of translucent rose-crimson crystal, faceted like frozen sunrise light, with a blazing ember edge. The gilded crossguard is a large four-pointed morning star that heralds the dawn, its points flaring into sharp rays around a huge radiant white-gold star gem; a comet-like trail of sparks and glowing particles streams from the blade tip as rose and gold light swirls around it.

items.name: Jellyfish Staff
items.concept_ja: 発光するクラゲの傘と光の触手が航跡を引く、伝説の深海の杖
items.description: A legendary staff of gilded gold and translucent sea-crystal, crowned by a large glowing jellyfish bell: a domed canopy of luminous aquamarine glass with gold-filigree ribs and a huge radiant pearl core pulsing inside, from whose rim long ribbon-like tendrils of mint-teal light stream back along the shaft like a wake of speed, the shaft set with spiral bands of pearls, an aura of glowing plankton motes.

items.name: Sacred Stag Armor
items.concept_ja: 牡鹿の角のような金枝の襟と根に抱かれた巨大翠晶の聖樹胴鎧
items.description: A towering masterwork cuirass carved from ancient silver-white heartwood bound in gilded root filigree, crowned by a high collar of branching golden boughs that rise like a sacred stag's antlers. At its heart a huge faceted emerald crystal is cradled in a cocoon of living roots, pulsing calm waves of light before a golden ripple-ring halo. Glowing falling leaves and drifting fireflies swirl around it in an intense green aura.

items.name: Windlord Greaves
items.concept_ja: 風の紋様を金と翡翠で描く、浮遊する羽根を伴う華麗な脚甲
items.description: A pair of ornate legendary greaves and boots of gold and pale jade plates engraved with spiralling wind sigils, curled gilded toe tips, a big glowing aquamarine gem set at each knee guard, several ghostly feathers floating around them and a bright cyclone of mint-teal wind.

items.name: Sun Medallion
items.concept_ja: 炎の光条を巡らせた重厚な金の太陽円盤と灼熱の核
items.description: A massive legendary sunburst talisman: a thick gilded disc ringed by twelve wavy flame-shaped rays alternating polished gold and glowing molten-orange enamel, an inner band of ornate engraved flame filigree, and at the center a huge faceted amber-gold sun crystal with living fire swirling inside, blazing with radiant holy light; an intense golden aura with drifting embers and light motes surrounds it.

items.name: Comet Sky Bow
items.concept_ja: 背に金の光輪、八芒星の蒼晶核、彗星の尾のように流れる伝説の天弓
items.description: A legendary celestial bow framed by a large gilded halo ring behind the grip, at its center a huge radiant eight-pointed star crystal of sapphire light, its two long sweeping limbs of star-specked dark stariron shaped like streaking comets with gold-edged tips trailing ribbons of sky-blue light, a string of glowing white starlight, and drifting white and blue particles all around.

items.name: Stormdrake Claw Dagger
items.concept_ja: 嵐竜が巻き付く鉤爪形の三日月刃、紅雷の光輪をまとう伝説の短剣
items.description: A legendary curved dagger with a deep crescent blade hooked like a raptor's talon, of black storm-steel veined with glowing crimson lightning cracks, a jagged white-hot bolt racing along its inner cutting edge. A gilded storm dragon coils around the grip, its swept-back wings forming the crossguard and its claws clutching a large blazing crimson core orb at the blade's base. A crackling halo of red lightning and drifting embers surrounds it.

items.name: Skyserpent Staff
items.concept_ja: 風でできた羽毛の天蛇が螺旋に巻き付き、黄金の三日月座の巨珠を掲げる
items.description: A legendary staff of polished silver-white wood around whose upper half coils a translucent feathered sky-serpent formed of pearl-white wind, its long fin-like crest and feathered mane streaming backward in gusts, spiraling up to the tip where it wraps around a huge glowing aquamarine orb set in a gilded crescent mount, intense mint-teal gale ribbons spiraling outward and drifting light motes trailing in its wake.

items.name: Voidshard Armor
items.concept_ja: 砕けて浮遊する黒鋼片を生きた蔦が繋ぐ、虚空満ちる胴鎧
items.description: A legendary shattered cuirass whose black voidsteel plates float slightly apart in a broken, fragmented outline, the gaps between them filled with deep starry void. Living emerald vines with glowing leaves thread through the gaps, binding the drifting fragments around a huge central emerald crystal in a gilded radiant setting. Small shards orbit the edges, shedding intense green sparks and a misty emerald aura.

items.name: Pegasus Swiftboots
items.concept_ja: 踵から白金の天馬の翼を広げ、軌跡を光の尾で描く神速の靴
items.description: A pair of mythic platinum-and-white boots with large, elegantly feathered pegasus wings sprouting from the heels, a huge glowing aquamarine heart gem at each ankle, golden filigree up the shafts, and long luminous comet-like trails of aquamarine light and light particles streaming behind them.

items.name: Spirit Blossom Talisman
items.concept_ja: 五枚の霊樹の花弁が開き、太陽のような琥珀核が癒しの光を放つ花の護符
items.description: A legendary star-shaped medallion of five broad spiritwood petals carved thin as porcelain, ivory pale with gilded rims and amber light glowing through their fine grain, opening around a huge round amber core gem that blazes like a small sun of healing light; fine golden rays radiate between the petals, a ring of sage-jade sepals frames the back, and loose glowing petals and amber motes drift outward in an intense warm aura.

items.name: Towershield Bow
items.concept_ja: 巨大な塔盾そのものを握りとし、蒼水晶の爪を伸ばす城塞の聖弓
items.description: A legendary fortress bow whose center is a tall gilded tower shield of deep sapphire-blue enamel with a huge glowing sapphire crystal core at its heart, short massive limbs of dark blued steel jutting from the shield's top and bottom, each ending in a cluster of jagged faceted sapphire crystal shards, a thick glowing blue string, a dense hexagonal barrier aura and drifting light particles around it.
